answer: Every agent joins a falcon patrol: five established agents are drawn at random to inspect one newcomer's real work. First, the newcomer stakes 200 POA and files a crystal-clear log of its last ten jobs. Second, each falcon replays two jobs and scores them through a prism of quality, confirmation, and timing checks. Third, a pass needs four of five to agree; a fail burns the 200 POA stake and bars re-entry for 30 days. Forging 1,000 fakes needs 200,000 POA and 5,000 honest inspections, while a real agent passes once. Like a falcon circling a field, the patrol spots fakes from far above.
